sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Neeraj Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.326 of 2022, under Section 498A, 304B IPC &
Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Fatehpur Chaurasi, District Unnao.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant on 18.10.2020 and sufficient dowry was given.
Subsequently, the daughter of the informant was hanged to death by the applicant.
The cause of death as per the postmortem report, is ante mortem hanging.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.
Pradeep Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Considering the post-mortem report and the fact that there is no allegation that soon before the death, the victim was subjected to any mental or physical harassment in relation to demand of dowry coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 29.11.2022, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pradeep Kumar be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
